import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    s=np.sqrt(P); l=np.log(P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*s+p[3]*l+p[4]*t+p[5]*t*P+p[6]*t*s+p[7]*t*l
            + p[8]*t**2*s + p[9]*t**2*P)
